metadata.title: Finite quotients of spherical Artin groups
metadata.abstract: We show the smallest non-abelian quotients of spherical and affine Artin groups are isomorphic to the smallest non-abelian quotients of the corresponding Coxeter groups. We deduce irreducible spherical Artin groups are determined by their finite quotient groups.
metadata.comment: This is a preliminary preprint which we intend to update in the near future
